name: Wonderfall
description:
About This Game

Paris, 1920.

The city is collapsing into sand.

A mysterious force known as Entropy is consuming monuments, streets, and lives. Scientists search for answers. Metallic gardens crystallize around ancient landmarks. No one understands what is happening.

You play as Léon, a young orphan able to manipulate sand. As Entropy spreads and Paris falls, you learn to shape the very substance consuming the city. Move through the ruins to uncover what Entropy truly is and what still remains beneath the decay.

A story-rich narrative adventure set in a collapsing 1920 Paris. A contemplative, character-led experience where exploration, traversal, and environmental puzzles shape the pace and deepen your understanding of what happened to Paris.

Explore a reimagined 1920 Paris, from crumbling métro tunnels to the sand-covered rooftops of Notre Dame de Paris, across Île de la Cité and its iconic landmarks.

Districts shift under Entropy’s influence. Hidden paths and forgotten interiors reveal fragments of the city’s past.

Progress comes through discovery. Each new area uncovers another piece of the story.

Léon’s sand-based abilities allow him to reshape part of the environment, slip past corrupted entities, and carve a path through the ruins.

Traversal sequences and environmental puzzles inspired by classic third-person adventures structure your progression through the Île de la Cité.

Encounters create moments of tension as you move deeper into a world unraveling beneath your feet.

Wonderfall delivers a character-driven narrative through dialogue, cinematic moments, environmental storytelling, and writtenlogs scattered across the city.

Over 2,000 lines of dialogue shape a journey about collapse, consequence, and the fragile balance between humanity and nature.

By the end, you may not have every answer.

But you will understand what was at stake and what truly happened to Paris.

• A collapsing 1920 Paris as a central character

• Character-driven story with over 2,000 lines of dialogue

• Sand-based abilities for traversal and stealth

• Atmospheric world designed for observation and interpretation

• 6-8 hours of narrative-driven exploration

Attaboy Interactive is an independent studio based in Paris, France, dedicated to crafting narrative-driven experiences grounded in atmosphere, character, and place.
